title: Desire’s wind blasts the thorntree
html_source:
From little acorns do mighty oaks grow
(with a hint of Spinozan conatus?).

anchor.prefix: foresaid riches in such dearth of money as was herebefore. His words were then these as followeth: Know all men, he said, time's ruins build eternity's mansions. What means this?
anchor.suffix: but after it becomes from a bramblebush to be a rose upon the rood of time. Mark me now. In woman's womb word is made flesh but in the spirit of the maker all flesh that passes be
